fields.Name: T134 - Create New Action Slide-in Panel
fields.Description: Bespoke new-action slide-in with a type-selector card UI + inline required-field validation (Errors map) — a distinct create path, not the generic entity 'New' record form.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, switch to the 'Actions' application, and open the 'Explorer' nav item. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Click the 'New Action' button in the header (top-right, plus icon). A slide-in panel titled 'New Action' should appear with an Action Type selector (AI Generated vs Custom cards), an Action Name field, a Description field, and a Category dropdown. Select an action type, then click 'Create Action' WITHOUT filling in the required Name to verify a validation message blocks the save. Then type a name and verify the validation clears. Seeing the slide-in panel render with the type selector and required-field validation is success — you do NOT need to complete the create.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking 'New Action' opens a slide-in panel with a title, an Action Type selector, a Name field, and a Category field
Selecting an action-type option highlights it as selected
Attempting to create with a blank required Name surfaces a validation/error message rather than silently saving
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
